essence: The ten-syllabled Ketu mantra must be chanted one hundred twenty thousand times.
Worship of this Ketu mantra causes the Ketus to move ahead of its practitioners.
When the planet-mother is angry, the presence of benefic planets is of no use.
The five powers enumerated are Ulkā, Siddhā, Saṃkaṭā, Vikaṭā, and Garbhapālikā.
The fruit manifests in name and form as a unified increase of both.
